text:
amanda: seeing a sudden p50->p99 spike in na-east since ~45s, tails up to 1.8s. throughput steady but GPU util on hotpool nodes jumped.
raj: on it, can you drop logs /link to dashboard?
amanda: https://dash.internal/redwood/na-east/serving latency heatmap, and kv-miss rate spiked x5. looks correlated with canary runtime rtv3.2 deployed ~10m ago by deploy-bot.
deploy-bot: Deploy rtv3.2 -> na-east-hotpool completed at 1991233400 by jules.
mike: kv cache eviction rate also jumped, I'm seeing many small batches queued then flushed, looks like batching window regressed to 80ms bursts.
kerri: oncall - we should throttle or route before blowing NA-east GPUs. can we flip routing policy to prefer na-west?
raj: will try traffic-shift to na-west by moving 20% now, 50% in 2min if stable. starting at 1991234590.
amanda: +1; also can we toggle continuous-batching off on runtime? config flag in config service: `continuous_batching.enabled`
mike: I can push runtime toggle as hot-config (no deploy). prepping patch: `PATCH /runtime/config {"continuous_batching.enabled": false}`
jules: hold on - that will increase per-request small calls cost but should drop tail latency. agree do it.
mike: applied patch at 1991234680, confirmed worker logs show batching window set to 0.
sre-bot: Alert suppressed: na-east tail latency reduced by 30% in 30s window.
amanda: latencies improving but kv-miss still high, evict storm left many tiny cache items. suggest manual kvcache compaction / TTL bump.
raj: spinning a kvcache compaction job on affected pools now. job id compact-199123. ETA ~90s.
jules: also starting reserved-capacity spin-up for na-east (2x small pools) to buy headroom while we monitor cost.
amanda: routing shift at 20% -> healthy, pushing to 50% now. no error spike in na-west.
mike: compaction completed at 1991234840. eviction rate normalized, p99 back near baseline.
kerri: great. what's next? rollback rtv3.2 or pin config until we root-cause?
raj: we should roll back canary to rtv3.1 in na-east and run smaller canary with kill-switch. rolling back now.
deploy-bot: Rollback rtv3.2 -> rtv3.1 initiated by raj at 1991234890.
amanda: running post-rollback checks, KV miss and batching metrics look stable.
jules: reserved capacity will be deprovisioned in 10m unless we need it; cost hit small but preferable to SLO burn.
kerri: please add incident note (short) with timeline and assign to eng-runtime for root cause: batching window regression in deploy.
amanda: assigning to eng-runtime ticket RT-987. attaching perf diffs.
raj: summary: mitigation = disable continuous batching (hot-config), kvcache compaction, traffic-shift to na-west, rollback runtime canary, spin up temporary reserved capacity. recommend CI gate on batching config next deploy.
mike: leaving a TODO to add automated circuit-breaker that disables continuous batching if p99>1s for 1m.
jules: thanks team, I'll follow up in eng-runtime channel with postmortem draft. :thumbsup:
amanda: good job everyone. closing thread once PM confirms postmortem created.
